title: finance.cash.counted, schema_version 1
description: A cash drawer (a till) was counted and held more or less than it should. Finance moves the difference between cash and cash over and short: short is Dr cash over and short / Cr cash, over the reverse. Amounts are integers in the currency's minor unit.

reference.description: The product's own reference for the count (a till number).

difference_minor.description: Counted minus expected: positive over, negative short.
